purpose: Finalize retrieval choice and select hackathon demo subjects before implementation
claimToTest: Within fixed English TikTok candidate sets, need-guided expansion can produce actionable reference examples beyond broad popular-content retrieval. No general precision or speed claim.

strategies.A: One need-guided visual asset search ranked by similarity and one expanded lexical query ranked by interactions.
strategies.B: Two broad domain lexical searches ranked by views and by interactions. Same domain pool, eligibility filters and page budget.

subjects.brief: Mobile app turns social posts into saved places on a personal map, for organizing restaurant/travel discoveries.
Mobile app identifies a place from visual/contextual clues when its name or address is not explicitly provided.
Mobile flashcard app helps students turn study material into practice and remember it through active recall.

rubric.adjacent: Same use context and concrete transferable value proposition
rubric.mechanism: A concrete reusable presentation mechanism with an explicit transfer

demoGate.rule: Gate applies to each candidate subject, not a declaration of statistical superiority.

limitations: Single exploratory retrieval trial per subject and strategy; not five repeated benchmark trials.
Prompts and terms generated by the assistant; automated planner/classifier not implemented.
Different query modalities intentionally compare end-to-end strategies; not isolated model components.
Global source coverage and paid distribution are unknown.
remainingChecks: Inspect early/full source evidence for selected subjects
Retrieve one same-creator cohort to verify feasibility, without claiming normalization quality
Freeze primary and fallback demo subjects
